description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-055 Computer Hardware Technician against its three linked records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's own governed module headings; a broad heading does not establish a more specific competency. COURSE-055 is the 6-month part-time weekend course; its headings 3 and 5 are cited by their governed text with the verified display corrections. NYSC citations keep the exact governed text; where the snapshot holds a verified display correction for that heading, display_text carries the corrected wording. Comparator cells are shared with the other Computer Hardware course. Coverage is never inferred from programme titles, qualification levels or unstored text.

pc_assembly: assembling or disassembling a computer from its hardware components
device_installation: installing or configuring internal or external devices or peripherals
software_installation: installing operating systems or application software
troubleshooting_repair: troubleshooting or fault diagnosis of computers
networking: setting up or configuring computer networks
internet_email: using or configuring internet access or email
network_security: securing networks against attacks or unauthorised access
workplace_safety: general workplace or occupational safety and health practice

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (for TESDA, unit titles).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: No independent Sri Lankan comparator with published modules was verified; the matrix has no Sri Lankan column.
TESDA 'Install and configure computer systems' is not read as naming devices, peripherals, operating systems or software.
ITE's general HSE elective modules are not part of this course's stored modules, so its workplace-safety cell is INSUFFICIENT_DATA, as for the ITE Electrician record.
